messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsTMT update
parts:
We were planning to release the new version of MSstatsTMT with Bioconductor 3.12. But it was postponed since we would like to perform more testing on the new version.

The new version is expected to be available in the Bioconductor development version by the end of this year.

-Ting
